name: Protected-Certificate Depth Is Unbounded on Ample Forbidden Minors
scope: Irredundantly embedded ample pc-minimal obstructions to dismantlable ampleness; the first family need not be reduction-terminal for $m>1$.
proof: The coordinate-block construction expands one removable tip into a fibre of $2^m-1$ successive corners above a negative base. Every stage peels relatively to a base with empty protected core and therefore also has empty protected core. A corner-choice tree must contain the entire fibre-deletion branch and still cannot stop at its endpoint, so its depth is at least $2^m$.
